visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with dyed highlights and a black hoodie sits in a brightly lit indoor room. He holds a large, matte black box vertically. Behind him, a large window shows greenery and sunlight. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese and English appear at the bottom. (2) He tilts the box, pointing his finger at a white label containing a QR code and technical specifications. The box surface reflects the indoor lighting. He speaks with active facial expressions and hand gestures. (3) A woman with long dark hair and a pink scarf enters from the background, leaning playfully on the man's shoulder. He holds a pair of pink scissors in his right hand. The background is a slightly blurred living area with shelving. (4) The camera cuts to a close-up of the man's face. Animated orange flames are overlaid on his eyes as he maintains a mock-serious expression. Yellow captions are visible. (5) He uses the pink scissors to pierce and slice through the clear plastic wrap on the box. He shows the words 'Tesla' and 'Levitating Cybertruck' printed in silver on the black cardboard. (6) He opens the box and pulls out a silver, angular vehicle model. He taps the side of the car with his fingernails to show it's made of plastic. The lighting creates sharp highlights on the car's metallic finish. (7) He removes a heavy-looking, circular black magnetic base from the box. A thick black Type-C cable is attached to the bottom. He holds it up, displaying its solid construction. (8) He holds a small, black 33W power adapter very close to the lens. The text on the adapter is visible but slightly blurred. (9) He carefully lowers the silver car model onto the black base. He uses both hands to find the magnetic center, with his fingers positioned around the edges of the car. (10) The car successfully floats several centimeters above the base. White front LED lights and red rear LED lights on the car model illuminate. He points to the lights with his finger. (11) He taps a touch-sensitive button on the front of the black base. The car's headlights and taillights turn off and on in response to his touch. (12) He gives the floating car model a gentle push, causing it to spin rapidly. He moves his head closer to the base, observing the rotation with a smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks Mandarin with moderate arousal and a friendly, conversational tone. A soft, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM with light percussion begins. The room tone is very clean with no significant noise. (2) The male voice continues, accompanied by the faint, high-frequency rustling of plastic wrap being touched. The guitar BGM remains at a consistent low volume. (3) A female voice enters the mix with a bright, curious intonation. The male voice responds with a playful, teasing tone. The BGM flows continuously under their dialogue. (4) A short, synthesized 'flame' or 'whoosh' sound effect with a wide spectral bandwidth plays for about one second. The male speaker pauses his speech briefly during this effect. (5) Distinct, loud crinkling and tearing sounds of plastic film dominate the audio layer. The male voice narrates over the sound, his tone remaining informative and steady. (6) Three sharp, percussive tapping sounds with a short decay are heard as the man knocks on the plastic object. His voice is close to the microphone, sounding clear and intimate. (7) A low-frequency 'thump' or 'thud' sound occurs as the heavy base is set on a wooden table. The male voice expresses surprise with a slight rise in pitch. (8) Faint metallic clicking sounds are audible as the man handles the charger. The acoustic guitar BGM continues its repetitive, calming loop. (9) The audio features several seconds of intense, focused silence from the speaker, with only the BGM and very soft friction sounds as he adjusts the model. (10) A subtle electronic 'click' or 'beep' SFX plays as the car's lighting system activates. The male speaker's voice returns with a high-energy, satisfied tone. (11) Multiple rhythmic, mechanical 'click' sounds are heard as the touch sensor is pressed. The man describes the action with a clear, enunciated broadcast style. (12) The man concludes with a higher pitch and faster speech rate, inviting audience interaction. The BGM fades out slightly as the video ends.
